name: SendHQ API
description: Send and receive expected email, manage verified domains and hosted templates, and inspect delivery outcomes. Stable major versions use URL paths such as /api/v1. Additive changes remain within the current major; breaking changes use a new major path. See /docs/versioning for the deprecation and sunset policy.
